'''Priority Alpha''' was meant as a last-resort emergency call, not one that was received every day.

==History==
A Priority Alpha message was sent to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. They took it in the [[Battle Operations Room]]. It said that [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] were heading to [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] to take it over. They found that out through the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].
